protocol_item: shared T3 external constant store feasibility before production decode
reason: previous combined-process probe crashed with native segmentation fault exit 139 after export/lowering; isolate process boundaries to localize the fault and preserve evidence
change_boundary: add a new isolated shared-store probe script
add a new diagnostic GitHub Actions workflow
do not modify accepted external prefill PTE/PTD bytes
do not modify comparator or thresholds
do not publish private Golden conditioning
do not claim production t3_decode acceptance
do not start Android runtime or APK changes
isolated_sequence: fresh process: export prefill and save source outputs + PTE + own PTD
fresh process: export decode storage probe and save source outputs + PTE + own PTD
fresh process: deserialize and merge the two NamedDataStore payloads, prove key/data compatibility, serialize one union t3_shared PTD
fresh process: real ExecuTorch prefill forward using prefill PTE + the union PTD
fresh process: real ExecuTorch decode forward using decode PTE + the same union PTD
fresh process: compare saved runtime outputs to saved source outputs and emit final gate evidence
diagnostic_rule: each stage gets start marker, /usr/bin/time -v resource report, exit-code marker, stage JSON when Python survives, and artifacts uploaded with if: always(); a segfault must not erase earlier-stage evidence
next_test: all six isolated stages PASS; both runtime stages consume a byte-identical union PTD SHA; prefill and decode outputs are finite/schema-correct and meet frozen numerical thresholds
rollback: reject the isolated probe artifacts and retain the already-qualified external prefill PTE/PTD unchanged
